Apple, Nvidia and AMD design some of the world's most famous chips. Another company builds them.

That company is TSMC in Taiwan, founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. It pioneered the pure-play foundry: it only manufactures chips its customers design, never its own. In 2025 it made 12,682 different products for 534 customers, and Britannica lists Apple, Nvidia and AMD as its top three clients.

TrendForce says TSMC took 72.5% of global foundry revenue from April to June 2026. Samsung had 5.9%. TSMC's share is more than 12 times bigger, and 11 of the 16 chip factories it lists are in Taiwan.

The lesson: the companies whose names are on the chips are often not the ones making them.

Source: TSMC; TrendForce, Sep 9, 2026; Britannica.
